title: Looker Connection Pool Errors
dataSources: Looker System Activity Explores (`looker:system_activity`), Looker API (`looker:api`), and instance logs.
app: Looker System Activity (i__looker) via DB Connect or the Looker API (`/api/4.0`); Looker instance logs via Universal Forwarder; scheduled plan and query events via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:system_activity source="history" status="error"
| search message="*connection*" OR message="*pool*" OR message="*too many connections*"
| stats count as errors, values(message) as messages by connection_name
| where errors>0
| sort - errors
description: Isolates Looker query errors caused by database connection-pool exhaustion or dropped connections, distinguishing infrastructure faults from bad LookML.
value: Connection errors make dashboards fail intermittently and are easy to blame on Looker; isolating them points teams at warehouse connection limits.
implementation: Filter history errors for connection messages; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on spikes per connection.
visualization: Table of connection by error count with messages.
grandmaExplanation: We catch when Looker cannot get a line to the database so the real cause of failing dashboards is clear.
